judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A clearly good sky photo with striking blue depth and layered cloud texture, though the light is fairly ordinary.
strengths: layered wispy and smooth cloud forms
good contrast between high clouds and lower cumulus bank
weaknesses: foreground forest is dark and incidental
upper clouds are thin and lack dramatic light
